name: Asking for Directions
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on asking for directions — practice these key phrases out loud:
Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
Go straight for two blocks, then turn left.
You can't miss it — it's right next to the bank.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
